title: Fred Hoaglin — two-time Super Bowl-winning assistant with Giants — dead at 82

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fred Hoaglin — two-time Super Bowl-winning assistant with Giants — dead at 82
sources.description: He was the Giants' offensive line coach from 1985-'92, during which he won two Super Bowls with the team -- in 1986-'97 and 1990-'91.
